data.name: GERAT
data.detailed_description:
GERAT is a roguelite game with spacecraft building elements! You can create your own spacecraft drone from blocks

that do different things. You need to take care of your propulsion, armor, resource production and *of course*, weapons.

A lot of them.

Each run is different - enemy territory is riddled with different kinds of enemies that require specific approach!

So deploy to the zone, extract resources, and fight to clear the zone to take back control of the Velomenda Funnel!

Play through the campaign alone or join multiplayer Versus mode that allows you to customize your experience with friends.

Features:

  • Arcade movement with auto-aiming and weapon grouping (control groups)

  • Random chest rewards system

  • Multiple kinds of enemies (Kamikaze, Sniper, Tank, Swarm)

  • Hangar bay and building view: Saving ships, selecting, copying, rotating, undo

  • Assignable perks system

  • Resource extraction system (fully destructable map)

  • Rogue-like gameplay (lose progress on death with meta-progression aspect)

  • Tech tree of blocks

  • Unique soundtrack

  • Multiplayer Versus Mode - customizable 5v5 lobby

  • Guard your Command Block as your heart of the spaceship, if it's destroyed, you're gone.

  • Group up your weaponry, Resource Gates and Modifiers into control groups - completely customizable!

  • Create simplified supply chains of resource pumps to conditionally feed your thrusters, energy production and other utilities that should be on every sci-fi ship!

  • Use Modifiers, Perks and wide variety of weaponry to have an advantage over enemies!

  • Choose your style: Glass cannon that moves fast and has a shield, big chunky tank that can take damage without a hassle or a completely melee spaceship.

  • Take care of extracting and processing resources on the map so you'll have the resources to fight.

  • Gain RC from enemies and mobs and spend them on unlocking more powerful blocks in the Tech Tree!

  • You start in your hangar and upon a quick look of the next map, you're deployed to the random zone that you must take care of.

  • If you are defeated, well... the enemies are quick to take the whole map back, so you're back at the Zone 1.

  • Each run is different, and gives you valuable information on how to progress further.

  • Use the map to your advantage: Hide between asteroids, utilize perks from chest to optimize your build and destroy mobs for resources!

  • Play the multiplayer Versus mode to battle in teams with your friends or Bots! Customizable 5v5 lobby is at your disposal.

data.short_description: Build, fuel and manage your spaceship using blocks and fight in space with enemies alike you in a roguelite fashion! Use your skills, weaponry and some luck to come to the last extraction zone!
data.supported_languages:
English*, Polish, Spanish - Spain, German
*languages with full audio support
